title: 第18章 到来第19章 考核
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: “那就叫它‘且慢’吧。”
下一刻，眼前的面板便发生了变化。
【能力：且慢（第一层：无法提升），广播体操（大成：20904000）】
“这一招，定然打人一个出其不意。”
沈长青咧起嘴角，对这个名字十分的满意。
“坏了，都已经过去四个多时辰了，我还没修炼太虚剑诀。”
突然，他脸色一紧，方才只顾着那一式剑招，却还没来得及修炼太虚剑诀，此刻他再看面板之时，眼神却陡然一滞。
【功法：太虚剑诀（未入门：179500），周天行气法（入门：3211000），养气术（圆满）】
“没想到我在感悟的同时，这些剑痕上留下的气息也在无形中淬炼着我的剑诀。”
沈长青注视着面前的玄色奇石，心道一声：“是了，说不定这上面有不少剑痕就是施展太虚剑诀所留下的。”
剩下的一点时间他也没浪费，而是开始修炼太虚剑诀。
且慢这一式剑招的开发需要借助对剑道的感悟，非寻常手段能提升，因此他并不强求。
转眼，又是半个多时辰。
【太虚剑诀：+21】
“在这里面修炼剑诀的效率果真不是外面能比的。”
沈长青能感觉到自己的剑诀在飞速提升，转瞬便又轻叹一声：“可惜，时间到了。”
一抹银辉照在身上，他最后望了奇石一眼，定了定心神，下一刻，他的身影已然是出现在了剑楼之外。
“沈师弟，可有收获？”
韩雨彤似有所感应，在沈长青出来的一瞬间她便出现在了剑楼外。
沈长青向她看去，强压下心中的心虚，点头道：“不愧是观内宝地，确实收获良多。”
韩雨彤来了兴趣，好奇问道：“那不知沈师弟觉得自己多久能将太虚剑诀修炼入门？”
沈长青认真想了想，说了个保守的期限，“大概两个月内吧。”
这个月还可以进剑楼一次，若平时再多苦修苦修，其实一个月内他便可以入门了。
韩雨彤神情一滞，笑道：“沈师弟果真悟性不凡。”
“你的情况宋师兄已经和我说了，十五天之后再来找我即可。”
沈长青没有再多说，转身离去。
望着他的背影，韩雨彤嘴角的笑意渐渐淡了下去。
几个呼吸后，她突然抬头看向了另一边。
只见那里飞来了一男一女两道身影。
男子衣着华丽，女子则颇为性感暴露，若是沈长青在此，定然能认出来人正是先前在李家遇到过的赵宏二人！
“咦，三师姐，莫非你知道我们要来，所以提前在此等候？”赵宏与卢采儿的身影飘然落地。
“小六，你说笑了。”
韩雨彤摇头一笑，道：“只是有位沈师弟刚走而已。”
赵宏正是云守拙座下第六位亲传，如今拥有化丹境前期的修为。
“沈师弟？”
赵宏心中忽的生出了种莫名的感觉，他追问道：“哪位沈师弟？”
content_en:
"Then just call it 'Wait a minute.'"
The next moment, the panel in front of him changed.
[Ability: Wait (first level: cannot be improved), Broadcast Gymnastics (Dacheng: 20904000)]
"This move will definitely catch someone by surprise."
Shen Changqing grinned, very satisfied with this name.
"It's broken. It's been more than four hours and I haven't practiced the Taixu Sword Art yet."
Suddenly, his face tightened. He was only focusing on that sword move, but before he had time to practice Taixu Sword Technique, when he looked at the panel again, his eyes suddenly stagnated.
[Skills: Taixu Sword Technique (Uninitiated: 179500), Zhoutian Qi Movement Technique (Entered: 3211000), Qi Nourishing Technique (Perfection)]
"I didn't expect that while I was comprehending, the aura left on these sword marks would also be invisibly refining my sword skills."
Shen Changqing stared at the strange black stone in front of him and thought to himself: "Yes, maybe there are many sword marks on it that were left by the Taixu Sword Technique."
He did not waste the remaining time, but began to practice the Taixu Sword Technique.
The development of this sword move requires the understanding of the sword, and it can be improved by unusual means, so he does not force it.
In the blink of an eye, it was more than half an hour.
[Taixu Sword Technique: +21]
[Kung Fu: Taixu Sword Technique (Uninitiated: 200500)...]
"The efficiency of practicing sword arts here is really not comparable to that outside."
Shen Changqing could feel that his sword skills were improving rapidly, and he sighed softly in an instant: "Unfortunately, the time has come."
A gleam of silver shone on him. He took one last look at the strange stone and calmed down. The next moment, his figure appeared outside the sword tower.
"Junior Brother Shen, have you gained anything?"
Han Yutong seemed to sense something, and she appeared outside the sword tower the moment Shen Changqing came out.
Shen Changqing looked at her, suppressed the guilt in his heart, and nodded: "It is indeed a treasured place in Guan Nei, and I have indeed gained a lot."
"Oh?"
Han Yutong became interested and asked curiously: "How long does it take for Junior Brother Shen to master the Taixu Sword Art?"
Shen Changqing thought about it seriously and gave a conservative deadline, "About two months."
He can enter the sword tower once this month. If he practices hard and diligently, he will actually be able to get started within a month.
Han Yutong's expression froze, and he smiled and said, "Junior Brother Shen really has extraordinary understanding."
"Senior Brother Song has already told me about your situation. Just come back to me in fifteen days."
"Okay."
Shen Changqing didn't say anything more, turned and left.
Looking at his back, the smile on Han Yutong's lips gradually faded.
After a few breaths, she suddenly raised her head and looked to the other side.
I saw two figures, a man and a woman, flying over there.
The man was dressed gorgeously, while the woman was quite sexy and exposed. If Shen Changqing were here, he would definitely recognize the two people as Zhao Hong and Zhao Hong who had met at Li's house before!
"Hey, Third Senior Sister, could it be that you knew we were coming, so you waited here in advance?" The figures of Zhao Hong and Lu Cai'er floated to the ground.
"Xiao Liu, you are joking."
Han Yutong shook his head, smiled, and said, "It's just that Junior Brother Shen just left."
Zhao Hong is the sixth direct successor of Yun Shouzhuo, and he now possesses the cultivation level of the early stage of the Alchemy Realm.
"Junior Brother Shen?"
Zhao Hong suddenly had an inexplicable feeling in his heart, and he asked: "Which Junior Brother Shen?"
